name: What is the typical timeline for completing a home extension project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for completing a home extension project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a home extension project varies, but generally, it involves several phases. Design and permitting can take 3-6 months, depending on the complexity of the plans and local city approval processes in areas like Los Angeles or Pasadena. Construction itself usually ranges from 4 to 12 months, influenced by the size of the extension, material availability, and weather. We work to establish a realistic schedule upfront and keep clients informed of progress.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical home extension timeline is 3-6 months for design and permitting, followed by 4-12 months for construction, varying by project scope.
